pokedex.emboar: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.
pokedex.oshawott: This Pokémon from the Unova region uses the shell on its belly as a weapon to cut down its foes. Thus, I've conferred upon this shell the name ”scalchop”.
pokedex.dewott: Its exquisite double-scalchop technique is likely the result of daily training, and it can send even masters of the blade fleeing in defeat.
pokedex.samurott: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.
pokedex.patrat: Extremely cautious, one of them will always be on the lookout, but it won’t notice a foe coming from behind.
pokedex.watchog: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.
pokedex.lillipup: This Pokémon is far brighter than the average child, and Lillipup won’t forget the love it receives or any abuse it suffers.
pokedex.herdier: The black fur that covers this Pokémon’s body is dense and springy. Even sharp fangs bounce right off.
pokedex.stoutland: Stoutland is immensely proud of its impressive moustache. It’s said that moustache length is what determines social standing among this species.
pokedex.purrloin: Opponents that get drawn in by its adorable behavior come away with stinging scratches from its claws and stinging pride from its laughter.
pokedex.liepard: This stealthy Pokémon sneaks up behind prey without making any sound at all. It competes with Thievul for territory.
pokedex.pansage: It’s good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It’s kind enough to share them with friends.
pokedex.simisage: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.
pokedex.pansear: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600 degrees Fahrenheit.
pokedex.simisear: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.
pokedex.panpour: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.
pokedex.simipour: It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.
pokedex.munna: It eats dreams and releases mist. The mist is pink when it’s eating a good dream, and black when it’s eating a nightmare.
pokedex.musharna: It drowses and dreams all the time. It’s best to leave it be if it’s just woken up, as it’s a terrible grump when freshly roused from sleep.
pokedex.pidove: It’s forgetful and not very bright, but many Trainers love it anyway for its friendliness and sincerity.
pokedex.tranquill: These bright Pokémon have acute memories. Apparently delivery workers often choose them as their partners.
pokedex.unfezant: This Pokémon is intelligent and intensely proud. People will sit up and take notice if you become the Trainer of one.
pokedex.blitzle: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.
pokedex.zebstrika: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.
pokedex.roggenrola: When it detects a noise, it starts to move. The energy core inside it makes this Pokémon slightly warm to the touch.
pokedex.boldore: It relies on sound in order to monitor what’s in its vicinity. When angered, it will attack without ever changing the direction it’s facing.
pokedex.gigalith: Although its energy blasts can blow away a dump truck, they have a limitation— they can only be fired when the sun is out.
pokedex.woobat: It emits ultrasonic waves as it flutters about, searching for its prey—bug Pokémon.
pokedex.swoobat: The auspicious shape of this Pokémon’s nose apparently led some regions to consider Swoobat a symbol of good luck.
pokedex.drilbur: It’s a digger, using its claws to burrow through the ground. It causes damage to vegetable crops, so many farmers have little love for it.
pokedex.excadrill: Known as the Drill King, this Pokémon can tunnel through the terrain at speeds of over 90 mph.
pokedex.audino: This Pokémon has a kind heart. By touching with its feelers, Audino can gauge other creatures’ feelings and physical conditions.
pokedex.timburr: Timburr that have started carrying logs that are about three times their size are nearly ready to evolve.
pokedex.gurdurr: Gurdurr excels at demolition—construction is not its forte. In any case, there’s skill in the way this Pokémon wields its metal beam.
pokedex.conkeldurr: When going all out, this Pokémon throws aside its concrete pillars and leaps at opponents to pummel them with its fists.
pokedex.tympole: It uses sound waves to communicate with others of its kind. People and other Pokémon species can’t hear its cries of warning.
pokedex.palpitoad: On occasion, their cries are sublimely pleasing to the ear. Palpitoad with larger lumps on their bodies can sing with a wider range of sounds.
pokedex.seismitoad: This Pokémon is popular among the elderly, who say the vibrations of its lumps are great for massages.
pokedex.throh: They train in groups of five. Any member that can’t keep up will discard its belt and leave the group.
pokedex.sawk: The karate chops of a Sawk that’s trained itself to the limit can cleave the ocean itself.
pokedex.sewaddle: Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes out of leaves, it is a popular mascot for fashion designers.
pokedex.swadloon: It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves. It stays on the move, eating leaves in forests.
pokedex.leavanny: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to make warm wrappings for Sewaddle.
pokedex.venipede: Its fangs are highly venomous. If this Pokémon finds prey it thinks it can eat, it leaps for them without any thought of how things might turn out.
pokedex.whirlipede: Whirlipede protects itself with a sturdy shell and poisonous spikes while it stores up the energy it’ll need for evolution.
pokedex.scolipede: Scolipede engage in fierce territorial battles with Centiskorch. At the end of one of these battles, the victor makes a meal of the loser.
pokedex.cottonee: Weaving together the cotton of both Cottonee and Eldegoss produces exquisite cloth that’s highly prized by many luxury brands.
pokedex.whimsicott: As long as this Pokémon bathes in sunlight, its cotton keeps growing. If too much cotton fluff builds up, Whimsicott tears it off and scatters it.
pokedex.petilil: The leaves on its head are highly valued for medicinal purposes. Dry the leaves in the sun, boil them, and then drink the bitter decoction for remarkably effective relief from fatigue.
pokedex.lilligant: I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.
pokedex.basculin: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.
pokedex.sandile: Sandile is small, but its legs and lower body are powerful. Pushing sand aside as it goes, Sandile moves through the desert as if it’s swimming.
pokedex.krokorok: Although this Pokémon has specialized eyes that allow it to see in the dark, Krokorok won’t move much at night—the desert gets cold after sunset.
pokedex.krookodile: While terribly aggressive, Krookodile also has the patience to stay hidden under sand for days, lying in wait for prey.
pokedex.darumaka: This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it’s pushed or pulled.
pokedex.darmanitan: This Pokémon’s power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.
pokedex.maractus: Once each year, this Pokémon scatters its seeds. They’re jam-packed with nutrients, making them a precious food source out in the desert.
pokedex.dwebble: It first tries to find a rock to live in, but if there are no suitable rocks to be found, Dwebble may move in to the ports of a Hippowdon.
pokedex.crustle: Its thick claws are its greatest weapons. They’re mighty enough to crack Rhyperior’s carapace.
pokedex.scraggy: It protects itself with its durable skin. It’s thought that this Pokémon will evolve once its skin has completely stretched out.
pokedex.scrafty: While mostly known for having the temperament of an aggressive ruffian, this Pokémon takes very good care of its family, friends, and territory.
pokedex.sigilyph: A discovery was made in the desert where Sigilyph fly. The ruins of what may have been an ancient city were found beneath the sands.
pokedex.yamask: The spirit of a person from a bygone age became this Pokémon. It rambles through ruins, searching for someone who knows its face.
pokedex.cofagrigus: There are many depictions of Cofagrigus decorating ancient tombs. They’re symbols of the wealth that kings of bygone eras had.
pokedex.tirtouga: Tirtouga is considered to be the ancestor of many turtle Pokémon. It was restored to life from a fossil.
pokedex.carracosta: This Pokémon emerges from the water in search of prey despite the fact that it moves more slowly on land.
pokedex.archen: Archen is said to be the ancestor of bird Pokémon. It lived in treetops, eating berries and bug Pokémon.
pokedex.archeops: Though capable of flight, Archeops was apparently better at hunting on the ground.
pokedex.trubbish: This Pokémon was born from a bag stuffed with trash. Galarian Weezing relish the fumes belched by Trubbish.
pokedex.garbodor: The toxic liquid it launches from its right arm is so virulent that it can kill a weakened creature instantly.
pokedex.zorua: A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.
pokedex.zoroark: With its disheveled white fur, it looks like an embodiment of death. Heedless of its own safety, Zoroark attacks its nemeses with a bitter energy so intense, it lacerates Zoroark's own body.
pokedex.minccino: They pet each other with their tails as a form of greeting. Of the two, the one whose tail is fluffier is a bit more boastful.
pokedex.cinccino: A special oil that seeps through their fur helps them avoid attacks. The oil fetches a high price at market.
pokedex.gothita: Even when nobody seems to be around, Gothita can still be heard making a muted cry. Many believe it’s speaking to something only it can see.
pokedex.gothorita: On nights when the stars shine, this Pokémon’s psychic power is at its strongest. It’s unknown just what link Gothorita has to the greater universe.
pokedex.gothitelle: A criminal who was shown his fate by a Gothitelle went missing that same day and was never seen again.
pokedex.solosis: Many say that the special liquid covering this Pokémon’s body would allow it to survive in the vacuum of space.
pokedex.duosion: Its brain has split into two, and the two halves rarely think alike. Its actions are utterly unpredictable.
pokedex.reuniclus: It’s said that drinking the liquid surrounding Reuniclus grants wisdom. Problem is, the liquid is highly toxic to anything besides Reuniclus itself.
pokedex.ducklett: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.
pokedex.swanna: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.
pokedex.vanillite: Supposedly, this Pokémon was born from an icicle. It spews out freezing air at −58 degrees Fahrenheit to make itself more comfortable.
pokedex.vanillish: It blasts enemies with cold air reaching −148 degrees Fahrenheit, freezing them solid. But it spares their lives afterward—it’s a kind Pokémon.
pokedex.vanilluxe: People believe this Pokémon formed when two Vanillish stuck together. Its body temperature is roughly 21 degrees Fahrenheit.
pokedex.deerling: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon’s fur. People use it to mark the seasons.
pokedex.sawsbuck: They migrate according to the seasons, so some people call Sawsbuck the harbingers of spring.
pokedex.emolga: This Pokémon absolutely loves sweet berries. Sometimes it stuffs its cheeks full of so much food that it can’t fly properly.
pokedex.karrablast: It spits a liquid from its mouth to melt through Shelmet’s shell. Karrablast doesn’t eat the shell— it eats only the contents.
pokedex.escavalier: It charges its enemies, lances at the ready. An image of one of its duels is captured in a famous painting of Escavalier clashing with Sirfetch’d.
pokedex.foongus: The spores released from this Pokémon’s hands are highly poisonous, but when thoroughly dried, the spores can be used as stomach medicine.
pokedex.amoonguss: Amoonguss generally doesn’t move much. It tends to stand still near Poké Balls that have been dropped on the ground.
pokedex.frillish: Legend has it that the residents of a sunken ancient city changed into these Pokémon.
pokedex.jellicent: Whenever a full moon hangs in the night sky, schools of Jellicent gather near the surface of the sea, waiting for their prey to appear.
pokedex.alomomola: The reason it helps Pokémon in a weakened condition is that any Pokémon coming after them may also attack Alomomola.
pokedex.joltik: Joltik latch on to other Pokémon and suck out static electricity. They’re often found sticking to Yamper’s hindquarters.
pokedex.galvantula: It lays traps of electrified threads near the nests of bird Pokémon, aiming to snare chicks that are not yet good at flying.
pokedex.ferroseed: Mossy caves are their preferred dwellings. Enzymes contained in mosses help Ferroseed’s spikes grow big and strong.
pokedex.ferrothorn: Its spikes are harder than steel. This Pokémon crawls across rock walls by stabbing the spikes on its feelers into the stone.
pokedex.klink: It’s suspected that Klink were the inspiration behind ancient people’s invention of the first gears.
pokedex.klang: Many companies in the Galar region choose Klang as their logo. This Pokémon is considered the symbol of industrial technology.
pokedex.klinklang: The three gears that compose this Pokémon spin at high speed. Its new spiked gear isn’t a living creature.
pokedex.tynamo: One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.
pokedex.eelektrik: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.
pokedex.eelektross: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.
pokedex.elgyem: This Pokémon was discovered about 50 years ago. Its highly developed brain enables it to exert its psychic powers.
pokedex.beheeyem: Sometimes found drifting above wheat fields, this Pokémon can control the memories of its opponents.
pokedex.litwick: The younger the life this Pokémon absorbs, the brighter and eerier the flame on its head burns.
pokedex.lampent: It lurks in cities, pretending to be a lamp. Once it finds someone whose death is near, it will trail quietly after them.
pokedex.chandelure: In homes illuminated by Chandelure instead of lights, funerals were a constant occurrence— or so it’s said.
pokedex.axew: They play with each other by knocking their large tusks together. Their tusks break sometimes, but they grow back so quickly that it isn’t a concern.
pokedex.fraxure: Its skin is as hard as a suit of armor. Fraxure’s favorite strategy is to tackle its opponents, stabbing them with its tusks at the same time.
pokedex.haxorus: While usually kindhearted, it can be terrifying if angered. Tusks that can slice through steel beams are how Haxorus deals with its adversaries.
pokedex.cubchoo: It sniffles before performing a move, using its frosty snot to provide an icy element to any move that needs it.
pokedex.beartic: It swims energetically through frigid seas. When it gets tired, it freezes the seawater with its breath so it can rest on the ice.
pokedex.cryogonal: When the weather gets hot, these Pokémon turn into water vapor. Cryogonal are almost never seen during summer.
pokedex.shelmet: It has a strange physiology that responds to electricity. When together with Karrablast, Shelmet evolves for some reason.
pokedex.accelgor: Discarding its shell made it nimble. To keep itself from dehydrating, it wraps its body in bands of membrane.
pokedex.stunfisk: For some reason, this Pokémon smiles slightly when it emits a strong electric current from the yellow markings on its body.
pokedex.mienfoo: Though small, Mienfoo’s temperament is fierce. Any creature that approaches Mienfoo carelessly will be greeted with a flurry of graceful attacks.
pokedex.mienshao: Delivered at blinding speeds, kicks from this Pokémon can shatter massive boulders into tiny pieces.
pokedex.druddigon: Druddigon are vicious and cunning. They take up residence in nests dug out by other Pokémon, treating the stolen nests as their own lairs.
pokedex.golett: This Pokémon was created from clay. It received orders from its master many thousands of years ago, and it still follows those orders to this day.
pokedex.golurk: There’s a theory that inside Golurk is a perpetual motion machine that produces limitless energy, but this belief hasn’t been proven.
pokedex.pawniard: A pack of these Pokémon forms to serve a Bisharp boss. Each Pawniard trains diligently, dreaming of one day taking the lead.
pokedex.bisharp: Violent conflicts erupt between Bisharp and Fraxure over places where sharpening stones can be found.
pokedex.bouffalant: These Pokémon live in herds of about 20 individuals. Bouffalant that betray the herd will lose the hair on their heads for some reason.
pokedex.rufflet: Its chick-like looks belie its hotheadedness. It challenges its parents at every opportunity, desperate to prove its strength.
pokedex.braviary: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water's surface.
pokedex.vullaby: Vullaby grow quickly. Bones that have gotten too small for older Vullaby to wear often get passed down to younger ones in the nest.
pokedex.mandibuzz: They adorn themselves with bones. There seem to be fashion trends among them, as different bones come into and fall out of popularity.
pokedex.heatmor: A flame serves as its tongue, melting through the hard shell of Durant so that Heatmor can devour their insides.
pokedex.durant: With their large mandibles, these Pokémon can crunch their way through rock. They work together to protect their eggs from Sandaconda.
pokedex.deino: Because it can’t see, this Pokémon is constantly biting at everything it touches, trying to keep track of its surroundings.
pokedex.zweilous: Their two heads will fight each other over a single piece of food. Zweilous are covered in scars even without battling others.
pokedex.hydreigon: The three heads take turns sinking their teeth into the opponent. Their attacks won’t slow until their target goes down.
pokedex.larvesta: Larvesta’s body is warm all over. It spouts fire from the tips of its horns to intimidate predators and scare prey.
pokedex.volcarona: This Pokémon emerges from a cocoon formed of raging flames. Ancient murals depict Volcarona as a deity of fire.
pokedex.cobalion: From the moment it’s born, this Pokémon radiates the air of a leader. Its presence will calm even vicious foes.
pokedex.terrakion: In Unovan legend, Terrakion battled against humans in an effort to protect other Pokémon.
pokedex.virizion: It darts around opponents with a flurry of quick movements, slicing them up with its horns.
pokedex.tornadus: This storm-stirring Pokémon is said to cause the seasons to turn by whipping up the air. I suspect its humanlike form to be a false one.
pokedex.thundurus: They say this wielder of electricity has waged war with its nemesis, Tornadus, since time immemorial. The lightning bolts it hurls pierce the very earth and enrich the soil.
pokedex.reshiram: According to myth, if people ignore truth and let themselves become consumed by greed, Reshiram will arrive to burn their kingdoms down.
pokedex.zekrom: Mythology tells us that if people lose the righteousness in their hearts, their kingdoms will be razed by Zekrom’s lightning.
pokedex.landorus: When the incarnations of wind and of lightning clash, Landorus arrives to quell the conflict. After the tempests and thunderbolts abate, the land is sure to be blessed with bountiful harvests.
pokedex.kyurem: It appears that this Pokémon uses its powers over ice to freeze its own body in order to stabilize its cellular structure.
pokedex.keldeo: They say that Keldeo must survive harsh battles and fully develop the horn on its forehead before this Pokémon’s true power will awaken.
pokedex.meloetta: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.
pokedex.genesect: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.
pokedex.chespin: Such a thick shell of wood covers its head and back that even a direct hit from a truck wouldn’t faze it.
pokedex.quilladin: They strengthen their lower bodies by running into one another. They are very kind and won’t start fights.
pokedex.chesnaught: When it takes a defensive posture with its fists guarding its face, it could withstand a bomb blast.
pokedex.fennekin: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.
pokedex.braixen: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.
pokedex.delphox: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.
pokedex.froakie: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.
pokedex.frogadier: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute’s time.
pokedex.greninja: It appears and vanishes with a ninja’s grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.
pokedex.bunnelby: It’s very sensitive to danger. The sound of Corviknight’s flapping will have Bunnelby digging a hole to hide underground in moments.
pokedex.diggersby: The fur on its belly retains heat exceptionally well. People used to make heavy winter clothing from fur shed by this Pokémon.
pokedex.fletchling: When this Pokémon gets excited, its body temperature increases sharply. If you touch a Fletchling with bare hands, you might get burned.
pokedex.fletchinder: Fletchinder are exceedingly territorial and aggressive. These Pokémon fight among themselves over feeding grounds.
pokedex.talonflame: Talonflame dives toward prey at speeds of up to 310 mph and assaults them with powerful kicks, giving the prey no chance to escape.
pokedex.scatterbug: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.
pokedex.spewpa: The beaks of bird Pokémon can’t begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.
pokedex.vivillon: The patterns on this Pokémon’s wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat. It scatters colorful scales.
pokedex.litleo: This hot-blooded Pokémon is filled with curiosity. When it gets angry or starts fighting, its short mane gets hot.
pokedex.pyroar: The temperature of its breath is over 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, but Pyroar doesn’t use it on its prey. This Pokémon prefers to eat raw meat.
pokedex.flabebe: Flabébé wears a crown made from pollen it’s collected from its flower. The crown has hidden healing properties.
pokedex.floette: It gives its own power to flowers, pouring its heart into caring for them. Floette never forgives anyone who messes up a flower bed.
pokedex.florges: Its life can span several hundred years. It’s said to devote its entire life to protecting gardens.
pokedex.skiddo: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn’t need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.
pokedex.gogoat: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.
pokedex.pancham: Wanting to make sure it’s taken seriously, Pancham’s always giving others a glare. But if it’s not focusing, it ends up smiling.
pokedex.pangoro: Using its leaf, Pangoro can predict the moves of its opponents. It strikes with punches that can turn a dump truck into scrap with just one hit.
pokedex.furfrou: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.
pokedex.espurr: There’s enough psychic power in Espurr to send a wrestler flying, but because this power can’t be controlled, Espurr finds it troublesome.
pokedex.meowstic: The defensive instinct of the males is strong. It’s when they’re protecting themselves or their partners that they unleash their full power.
pokedex.honedge: The blue eye on the sword’s handguard is the true body of Honedge. With its old cloth, it drains people’s lives away.
pokedex.doublade: The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly alternating between offense and defense to bring down their prey.
pokedex.aegislash: Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate others. It once used its powers to force people and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.
pokedex.spritzee: The scent its body gives off enraptures those who smell it. Noble ladies had no shortage of love for Spritzee.
pokedex.aromatisse: The scents Aromatisse can produce range from sweet smells that bolster allies to foul smells that sap an opponent’s will to fight.
pokedex.swirlix: The sweet smell of cotton candy perfumes Swirlix’s fluffy fur. This Pokémon spits out sticky string to tangle up its enemies.
pokedex.slurpuff: Slurpuff’s fur contains a lot of air, making it soft to the touch and lighter than it looks.
pokedex.inkay: By exposing foes to the blinking of its luminescent spots, Inkay demoralizes them, and then it seizes the chance to flee.
pokedex.malamar: It’s said that Malamar’s hypnotic powers played a role in certain history-changing events.
pokedex.binacle: If the two don’t work well together, both their offense and defense fall apart. Without good teamwork, they won’t survive.
pokedex.barbaracle: Having an eye on each palm allows it to keep watch in all directions. In a pinch, its limbs start to act on their own to ensure the enemy’s defeat.
pokedex.skrelp: Skrelp looks like a piece of rotten seaweed, so it can blend in with seaweed drifting on the ocean and avoid being detected by enemies.
pokedex.dragalge: Dragalge generates dragon energy by sticking the plume on its head out above the ocean’s surface and bathing it in sunlight.
pokedex.clauncher: By detonating gas that accumulates in its right claw, this Pokémon launches water like a bullet. This is how Clauncher defeats its enemies.
pokedex.clawitzer: Clawitzer’s right arm is a cannon that launches projectiles made of seawater. Shots from a Clawitzer’s cannon arm can sink a tanker.
pokedex.helioptile: The sun powers this Pokémon’s electricity generation. Interruption of that process stresses Helioptile to the point of weakness.
pokedex.heliolisk: One Heliolisk basking in the sun with its frill outspread is all it would take to produce enough electricity to power a city.
pokedex.tyrunt: This Pokémon is selfish and likes to be pampered. It can also inflict grievous wounds on its Trainer just by playing around.
pokedex.tyrantrum: A single bite of Tyrantrum’s massive jaws will demolish a car. This Pokémon was the king of the ancient world.
pokedex.amaura: Amaura is an ancient Pokémon that has gone extinct. Specimens of this species can sometimes be found frozen in ice.
pokedex.aurorus: When gripped by rage, Aurorus will emanate freezing air, covering everything around it in ice.
pokedex.sylveon: It emits a soothing aura from its ribbon-shaped organs. It wraps these appendages around quarrelers to instantly restore calm to the situation.
pokedex.hawlucha: It always strikes a pose before going for its finishing move. Sometimes opponents take advantage of that time to counterattack.
pokedex.dedenne: Since Dedenne can’t generate much electricity on its own, it steals electricity from outlets or other electric Pokémon.
pokedex.carbink: It’s said that somewhere in the world, there’s a mineral vein housing a large pack of slumbering Carbink. It’s also said that this pack has a queen.
pokedex.goomy: Goomy hides away in the shade of trees, where it's nice and humid. If the slime coating its body dries out, the Pokémon instantly becomes lethargic.
pokedex.sliggoo: A creature given to melancholy. I suspect its metallic shell developed as a result of the mucus on its skin reacting with the iron in Hisui's water.
pokedex.goodra: Able to freely control the hardness of its metallic shell. It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy—it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.
pokedex.klefki: Klefki sucks in metal ions with the horn topping its head. It seems this Pokémon loves keys so much that its head needed to look like one, too.
pokedex.phantump: With a voice like a human child’s, it cries out to lure adults deep into the forest, getting them lost among the trees.
pokedex.trevenant: Small roots that extend from the tips of this Pokémon’s feet can tie into the trees of the forest and give Trevenant control over them.
pokedex.pumpkaboo: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.
pokedex.gourgeist: In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist will come knocking. Whoever answers the door will be swept off to the afterlife.
pokedex.bergmite: Lives on mountains blanketed in perennial snow. It freezes water vapor in the air to make the ice helmet that it dons for defense.
pokedex.avalugg: The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease. This Pokémon barrels along steep mountain paths, cleaving through the deep snow.
pokedex.noibat: No wavelength of sound is beyond Noibat’s ability to produce. The ultrasonic waves it generates can overcome much larger Pokémon.
pokedex.noivern: Flying through the darkness, it weakens enemies with ultrasonic waves that could crush stone. Its fangs finish the fight.
pokedex.xerneas: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.
pokedex.yveltal: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.
pokedex.zygarde: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.
pokedex.diancie: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.
pokedex.hoopa: It is said to be able to seize anything it desires with its six rings and six huge arms. With its power sealed, it is transformed into a much smaller form.
pokedex.volcanion: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.
pokedex.rowlet: Flies noiselessly on delicate wings. It has mastered the art of deftly launching dagger-sharp feathers from those same wings.
pokedex.dartrix: Regularly basks in sunlight to gather power—presumably due to the frigid climate. Nonetheless, the edges of the blade quills set into its wings are keen as ever.
pokedex.decidueye: The air stored inside the rachises of Decidueye's feathers insulates the Pokémon against Hisui's extreme cold. This is firm proof that evolution can be influenced by environment.
pokedex.litten: Trying to pet Litten before it trusts you will result in a nasty scratch from its sharp claws. Be careful.
pokedex.torracat: When facing a powerful enemy, Torracat’s fighting spirit gets pumped up, and its fire bell blazes hotter.
pokedex.incineroar: Incineroar’s rough and aggressive behavior is its most notable trait, but the way it helps out small Pokémon shows that it has a kind side as well.
pokedex.popplio: If Popplio want to create big, powerful balloons, they must be persistent. It takes daily practice for these Pokémon to develop their skills.
pokedex.brionne: On nights when the sea is calm, Brionne dance with one another to the singing of the Primarina that’s leading them.
pokedex.primarina: For Primarina, every battle’s a stage. Its singing and the dancing of its balloons will mesmerize the audience.
pokedex.pikipek: It may look spindly, but its neck muscles are heavy-duty. It can peck at a tree 16 times per second!
pokedex.trumbeak: From its mouth, it fires the seeds of berries it has eaten. The scattered seeds give rise to new plants.
pokedex.toucannon: Known for forming harmonious couples, this Pokémon is brought to wedding ceremonies as a good luck charm.
pokedex.yungoos: Although it will eat anything, it prefers fresh living things, so it marches down streets in search of prey.
pokedex.gumshoos: Patient by nature, this Pokémon loses control of itself and pounces when it spots its favorite meal—Rattata!
pokedex.grubbin: It uses its big jaws to dig nests into the forest floor, and it loves to feed on sweet tree sap.
pokedex.charjabug: Its digestive processes convert the leaves it eats into electricity. An electric sac in its belly stores the electricity for later use.
pokedex.vikavolt: If it carries a Charjabug to use as a spare battery, a flying Vikavolt can rapidly fire high-powered beams of electricity.
pokedex.crabrawler: Crabrawler has been known to mistake Exeggutor for a coconut tree and climb it. The enraged Exeggutor shakes it off and stomps it.
pokedex.crabominable: Before it stops to think, it just starts pummeling. There are records of its turning back avalanches with a flurry of punches.
pokedex.oricorio: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.
pokedex.cutiefly: An opponent’s aura can tell Cutiefly what that opponent’s next move will be. Then Cutiefly can glide around the attack and strike back.
pokedex.ribombee: Ribombee absolutely hate getting wet or rained on. In the cloudy Galar region, they are very seldom seen.
pokedex.rockruff: This Pokémon intimidates opponents by striking the ground with the rocks on its neck. The moment an opponent flinches, Rockruff attacks.
pokedex.lycanroc: With swift movements, this Pokémon gradually backs its prey into a corner. Lycanroc’s fangs are always aimed toward opponents’ weak spots.
pokedex.wishiwashi: When it senses danger, its eyes tear up. The sparkle of its tears signals other Wishiwashi to gather.
pokedex.mareanie: Unlike their Alolan counterparts, the Mareanie of the Galar region have not yet figured out that the branches of Corsola are delicious.
pokedex.toxapex: Within the poison sac in its body is a poison so toxic that Pokémon as large as Wailord will still be suffering three days after it first takes effect.
pokedex.mudbray: It eats dirt to create mud and smears this mud all over its feet, giving them the grip needed to walk on rough terrain without slipping.
pokedex.mudsdale: Mudsdale has so much stamina that it could carry over 10 tons across the Galar region without rest or sleep.
pokedex.dewpider: Dewpider normally lives underwater. When it comes onto land in search of food, it takes water with it in the form of a bubble on its head.
pokedex.araquanid: It acts as a caretaker for Dewpider, putting them inside its bubble and letting them eat any leftover food.
pokedex.fomantis: During the day, Fomantis basks in sunlight and sleeps peacefully. It wakes and moves around at night.
pokedex.lurantis: The petals on this Pokémon’s arms are thin and super sharp, and they can fire laser beams if Lurantis gathers light first.
pokedex.morelull: Morelull live in forests that stay dark even during the day. They scatter flickering spores that put enemies to sleep.
pokedex.shiinotic: If you see a light deep in a forest at night, don’t go near. Shiinotic will make you fall fast asleep.
pokedex.salandit: This sneaky Pokémon will slink behind its prey and immobilize it with poisonous gas before the prey even realizes Salandit is there.
pokedex.salazzle: The winner of competitions between Salazzle is decided by which one has the most male Salandit with it.
pokedex.stufful: The way it protects itself by flailing its arms may be an adorable sight, but stay well away. This is flailing that can snap thick tree trunks.
pokedex.bewear: The moves it uses to take down its prey would make a martial artist jealous. It tucks subdued prey under its arms to carry them to its nest.
pokedex.bounsweet: When under attack, it secretes a sweet and delicious sweat. The scent only calls more enemies to it.
pokedex.steenee: Any Corvisquire that pecks at this Pokémon will be greeted with a smack from its sepals followed by a sharp kick.
pokedex.tsareena: A kick from the hardened tips of this Pokémon’s legs leaves a wound in the opponent’s body and soul that will never heal.
pokedex.comfey: These Pokémon smell very nice. All Comfey wear different flowers, so each of these Pokémon has its own individual scent.
pokedex.oranguru: It knows the forest inside and out. If it comes across a wounded Pokémon, Oranguru will gather medicinal herbs to treat it.
pokedex.passimian: Passimian live in groups of about 20, with each member performing an assigned role. Through cooperation, the group survives.
pokedex.wimpod: Wimpod gather in swarms, constantly on the lookout for danger. They scatter the moment they detect an enemy’s presence.
pokedex.golisopod: They live in sunken ships or in holes in the seabed. When Golisopod and Grapploct battle, the loser becomes the winner’s meal.
pokedex.sandygast: Sandygast mainly inhabits beaches. It takes control of anyone who puts their hand into its mouth, forcing them to make its body bigger.
pokedex.palossand: This Pokémon lives on beaches, but it hates water. Palossand can’t maintain its castle-like shape if it gets drenched by a heavy rain.
pokedex.pyukumuku: It’s covered in a slime that keeps its skin moist, allowing it to stay on land for days without drying up.
pokedex.type-null: It was modeled after a mighty Pokémon of myth. The mask placed upon it limits its power in order to keep it under control.
pokedex.silvally: The final factor needed to release this Pokémon’s true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.
pokedex.minior: Although its outer shell is uncommonly durable, the shock of falling to the ground smashes the shell to smithereens.
pokedex.komala: It remains asleep from birth to death as a result of the sedative properties of the leaves that form its diet.
pokedex.turtonator: Eating sulfur in its volcanic habitat is what causes explosive compounds to develop in its shell. Its droppings are also dangerously explosive.
pokedex.togedemaru: When it’s in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.
pokedex.mimikyu: There was a scientist who peeked under Mimikyu’s old rag in the name of research. The scientist died of a mysterious disease.
pokedex.bruxish: Its skin is thick enough to fend off Mareanie’s spikes. With its robust teeth, Bruxish crunches up the spikes and eats them.
pokedex.drampa: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it’s angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.
pokedex.dhelmise: After lowering its anchor, it waits for its prey. It catches large Wailord and drains their life-force.
pokedex.jangmo-o: Jangmo-o strikes its scales to communicate with others of its kind. Its scales are actually fur that’s become as hard as metal.
pokedex.hakamo-o: Before attacking its enemies, it clashes its scales together and roars. Its sharp claws shred the opposition.
pokedex.kommo-o: Certain ruins have paintings of ancient warriors wearing armor made of Kommo-o scales.
pokedex.tapu-koko: The lightning-wielding guardian deity of Melemele, Tapu Koko is brimming with curiosity and appears before people from time to time.
pokedex.tapu-lele: Although called a guardian deity, Tapu Lele is devoid of guilt about its cruel disposition and can be described as nature incarnate.
pokedex.tapu-bulu: It makes ringing sounds with its tail to let others know where it is, avoiding unneeded conflicts. This guardian deity of Ula’ula controls plants.
pokedex.tapu-fini: Although it’s called a guardian deity, terrible calamities sometimes befall those who recklessly approach Tapu Fini.
pokedex.cosmog: Cosmog is very curious but not very cautious, often placing itself in danger. If things start to look dicey, it teleports away.
pokedex.cosmoem: It sucks in dust from the air at an astounding rate, frantically building up energy within its core as preparation for evolution.
pokedex.solgaleo: Solgaleo was once known as the Beast That Devours the Sun. Energy in the form of light radiates boundlessly from it.
pokedex.lunala: It steals the light from its surroundings and then becomes the full moon, showering its own light across the night sky.
pokedex.nihilego: It appeared in this world from an Ultra Wormhole. Nihilego appears to be a parasite that lives by feeding on people and Pokémon.
pokedex.buzzwole: Buzzwole goes around showing off its abnormally swollen muscles. It is one kind of Ultra Beast.
pokedex.pheromosa: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.
pokedex.xurkitree: They’ve been dubbed Ultra Beasts. Some of them stand unmoving, like trees, with their arms and legs stuck into the ground.
pokedex.celesteela: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.
pokedex.kartana: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.
pokedex.guzzlord: An unknown life-form called a UB. It may be constantly hungry—it is certainly always devouring something.
pokedex.necrozma: It needs light to survive, and it goes on a rampage seeking it out. Its laser beams will cut anything to pieces.
pokedex.magearna: Built roughly 500 years ago by a scientist, the part called the Soul-Heart is the actual life-form.
pokedex.marshadow: This Pokémon can conceal itself in any shadow, so it went undiscovered for a long time.
pokedex.poipole: An Ultra Beast that lives in a different world, it cackles wildly as it sprays its opponents with poison from the needles on its head.
pokedex.naganadel: One kind of Ultra Beast, it fires a glowing, venomous liquid from its needles. This liquid is also immensely adhesive.
pokedex.stakataka: When stone walls started moving and attacking, the brute’s true identity was this mysterious life-form, which brings to mind an Ultra Beast.
pokedex.blacephalon: A UB that appeared from an Ultra Wormhole, it causes explosions, then takes advantage of opponents’ surprise to rob them of their vitality.
pokedex.zeraora: Electricity sparks from the pads on its limbs. Wherever Zeraora runs, lightning flashes and thunder echoes.
pokedex.meltan: They live as a group, but when the time comes, one strong Meltan will absorb all the others and evolve.
pokedex.melmetal: Centrifugal force is behind the punches of Melmetal’s heavy hex-nut arms. Melmetal is said to deliver the strongest punches of all Pokémon.
pokedex.grookey: It attacks with rapid beats of its stick. As it strikes with amazing speed, it gets more and more pumped.
pokedex.thwackey: When it’s drumming out rapid beats in battle, it gets so caught up in the rhythm that it won’t even notice that it’s already knocked out its opponent.
pokedex.rillaboom: The one with the best drumming techniques becomes the boss of the troop. It has a gentle disposition and values harmony among its group.
pokedex.scorbunny: It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and one on its nose. Once it’s raring to fight, these pads radiate tremendous heat.
pokedex.raboot: It kicks berries right off the branches of trees and then juggles them with its feet, practicing its footwork.
pokedex.cinderace: It’s skilled at both offense and defense, and it gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.
pokedex.sobble: When it gets wet, its skin changes color, and this Pokémon becomes invisible as if it were camouflaged.
pokedex.drizzile: Highly intelligent but also very lazy, it keeps enemies out of its territory by laying traps everywhere.
pokedex.inteleon: Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes’ weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.
pokedex.skwovet: It eats berries nonstop—a habit that has made it more resilient than it looks. It’ll show up on farms, searching for yet more berries.
pokedex.greedent: Common throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon has strong teeth and can chew through the toughest of berry shells.
pokedex.rookidee: Jumping nimbly about, this small-bodied Pokémon takes advantage of even the slightest opportunity to disorient larger opponents.
pokedex.corvisquire: The lessons of many harsh battles have taught it how to accurately judge an opponent’s strength.
pokedex.corviknight: With their great intellect and flying skills, these Pokémon very successfully act as the Galar region’s airborne taxi service.
pokedex.blipbug: Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairs on its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.
pokedex.dottler: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor the outside world and prepare for evolution.
pokedex.orbeetle: It emits psychic energy to observe and study what’s around it—and what’s around it can include things over six miles away.
pokedex.nickit: Cunning and cautious, this Pokémon survives by stealing food from others. It erases its tracks with swipes of its tail as it makes off with its plunder.
pokedex.thievul: With a lithe body and sharp claws, it goes around stealing food and eggs. Boltund is its natural enemy.
pokedex.gossifleur: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.
pokedex.eldegoss: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.
pokedex.wooloo: If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won’t be able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this Pokémon is surprisingly strong.
pokedex.dubwool: Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender. They never see use in battle.
pokedex.chewtle: It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.
pokedex.drednaw: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.
pokedex.yamper: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.
pokedex.boltund: It sends electricity through its legs to boost their strength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks 50 mph.
pokedex.rolycoly: It can race around like a unicycle, even on rough, rocky terrain. Burning coal sustains it.
pokedex.carkol: By rapidly rolling its legs, it can travel at over 18 mph. The temperature of the flames it breathes exceeds 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.
pokedex.coalossal: While it’s engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, sending off sparks that scorch the surrounding area.
pokedex.applin: As soon as it’s born, it burrows into an apple. Not only does the apple serve as its food source, but the flavor of the fruit determines its evolution.
pokedex.flapple: It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a powerful acid. It can also change its shape into that of an apple.
pokedex.appletun: Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially yummy. Children used to have it as a snack.
pokedex.silicobra: It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.
pokedex.sandaconda: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.
pokedex.cramorant: This hungry Pokémon swallows Arrokuda whole. Occasionally, it makes a mistake and tries to swallow a Pokémon other than its preferred prey.
pokedex.arrokuda: After it’s eaten its fill, its movements become extremely sluggish. That’s when Cramorant swallows it up.
pokedex.barraskewda: It spins its tail fins to propel itself, surging forward at speeds of over 100 knots before ramming prey and spearing into them.
pokedex.toxel: It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison to produce electricity. The voltage is weak, but it can cause a tingling paralysis.
pokedex.toxtricity: This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.
pokedex.sizzlipede: It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they’re well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.
pokedex.centiskorch: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.
pokedex.clobbopus: Its tentacles tear off easily, but it isn’t alarmed when that happens—it knows they’ll grow back. It’s about as smart as a three-year-old.
pokedex.grapploct: Searching for an opponent to test its skills against, it emerges onto land. Once the battle is over, it returns to the sea.
pokedex.sinistea: The teacup in which this Pokémon makes its home is a famous piece of antique tableware. Many forgeries are in circulation.
pokedex.polteageist: Leaving leftover black tea unattended is asking for this Pokémon to come along and pour itself into it, turning the tea into a new Polteageist.
pokedex.hatenna: If this Pokémon senses a strong emotion, it will run away as fast as it can. It prefers areas without people.
pokedex.hattrem: Using the braids on its head, it pummels foes to get them to quiet down. One blow from those braids would knock out a professional boxer.
pokedex.hatterene: If you’re too loud around it, you risk being torn apart by the claws on its tentacle. This Pokémon is also known as the Forest Witch.
pokedex.impidimp: It sneaks into people’s homes, stealing things and feasting on the negative energy of the frustrated occupants.
pokedex.morgrem: With sly cunning, it tries to lure people into the woods. Some believe it to have the power to make crops grow.
pokedex.grimmsnarl: Its hairs work like muscle fibers. When its hairs unfurl, they latch on to opponents, ensnaring them as tentacles would.
pokedex.obstagoon: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.
pokedex.perrserker: After many battles, it evolved dangerous claws that come together to form daggers when extended.
pokedex.cursola: Be cautious of the ectoplasmic body surrounding its soul. You’ll become stiff as stone if you touch it.
pokedex.sirfetchd: After deflecting attacks with its hard leaf shield, it strikes back with its sharp leek stalk. The leek stalk is both weapon and food.
pokedex.mr-rime: Its amusing movements make it very popular. It releases its psychic power from the pattern on its belly.
pokedex.runerigus: Never touch its shadowlike body, or you’ll be shown the horrific memories behind the picture carved into it.
pokedex.milcery: They say that any patisserie visited by Milcery is guaranteed success and good fortune.
pokedex.alcremie: When Alcremie is content, the cream it secretes from its hands becomes sweeter and richer.
pokedex.falinks: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.
pokedex.pincurchin: It stores electricity in each spine. Even if one gets broken off, it still continues to emit electricity for at least three hours.
pokedex.snom: It eats snow that piles up on the ground. The more snow it eats, the bigger and more impressive the spikes on its back grow.
pokedex.frosmoth: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.
pokedex.stonjourner: Once a year, on a specific date and at a specific time, they gather out of nowhere and form up in a circle.
pokedex.eiscue: This Pokémon keeps its heat-sensitive head cool with ice. It fishes for its food, dangling its single hair into the sea to lure in prey.
pokedex.indeedee: Through its horns, it can pick up on the emotions of creatures around it. Positive emotions are the source of its strength.
pokedex.morpeko: It carries electrically roasted seeds with it as if they’re precious treasures. No matter how much it eats, it always gets hungry again in short order.
pokedex.cufant: If a job requires serious strength, this Pokémon will excel at it. Its copper body tarnishes in the rain, turning a vibrant green color.
pokedex.copperajah: These Pokémon live in herds. Their trunks have incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush giant rocks into powder.
pokedex.dracozolt: The powerful muscles in its tail generate its electricity. Compared to its lower body, its upper half is entirely too small.
pokedex.arctozolt: This Pokémon lived on prehistoric seashores and was able to preserve food with the ice on its body. It went extinct because it moved so slowly.
pokedex.dracovish: Its mighty legs are capable of running at speeds exceeding 40 mph, but this Pokémon can’t breathe unless it’s underwater.
pokedex.arctovish: The skin on its face is impervious to attack, but breathing difficulties made this Pokémon go extinct anyway.
pokedex.duraludon: The special metal that composes its body is very light, so this Pokémon has considerable agility. It lives in caves because it dislikes the rain.
pokedex.dreepy: If this weak Pokémon is by itself, a mere child could defeat it. But if Dreepy has friends to help it train, it can evolve and become much stronger.
pokedex.drakloak: Without a Dreepy to place on its head and care for, it gets so uneasy it’ll try to substitute any Pokémon it finds for the missing Dreepy.
pokedex.dragapult: Apparently the Dreepy inside Dragapult’s horns eagerly look forward to being launched out at Mach speeds.
pokedex.zacian: This Pokémon has slumbered for many years. Some say it’s Zamazenta’s elder sister—others say the two Pokémon are rivals.
pokedex.zamazenta: This Pokémon slept for aeons while in the form of a statue. It was asleep for so long, people forgot that it ever existed.
pokedex.eternatus: It was inside a meteorite that fell 20,000 years ago. There seems to be a connection between this Pokémon and the Dynamax phenomenon.
pokedex.kubfu: If Kubfu pulls the long white hair on its head, its fighting spirit heightens and power wells up from the depths of its belly.
pokedex.urshifu: Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, this Pokémon races across sheer cliffs, training its legs and refining its moves.
pokedex.zarude: Once the vines on Zarude’s body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.
pokedex.regieleki: Its entire body is made up of a single organ that generates electrical energy. Regieleki is capable of creating all Galar’s electricity.
pokedex.regidrago: Its body is composed of crystallized dragon energy. Regidrago is said to have the powers of every dragon Pokémon.
pokedex.glastrier: Glastrier has tremendous physical strength, and the mask of ice covering its face is 100 times harder than diamond.
pokedex.spectrier: As it dashes through the night, Spectrier absorbs the life-force of sleeping creatures. It craves silence and solitude.
pokedex.calyrex: Calyrex is known in legend as a king that ruled over Galar in ancient times. It has the power to cause hearts to mend and plants to spring forth.
pokedex.wyrdeer: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.
pokedex.kleavor: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.
pokedex.ursaluna: I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.
pokedex.basculegion: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.
pokedex.sneasler: Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.
pokedex.overqwil: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname ”sea fiend.” It slurps up poison to nourish itself.
pokedex.enamorus: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.
pokedex.sprigatito: The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.
pokedex.floragato: The hardness of Floragato’s fur depends on the Pokémon’s mood. When Floragato is prepared to battle, its fur becomes pointed and needle sharp.
pokedex.meowscarada: With skillful misdirection, it rigs foes with pollen-packed flower bombs. Meowscarada sets off the bombs before its foes realize what’s going on.
pokedex.fuecoco: Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco’s head and flickers to and fro.
pokedex.crocalor: The valve in Crocalor’s flame sac is closely connected to its vocal cords. This Pokémon utters a guttural cry as it spews flames every which way.
pokedex.skeledirge: Skeledirge’s gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it. It burns its enemies to a crisp with flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.
pokedex.quaxly: Its strong legs let it easily swim around in even fast-flowing rivers. It likes to keep things tidy and is prone to overthinking things.
pokedex.quaxwell: The hardworking Quaxwell observes people and Pokémon from various regions and incorporates their movements into its own dance routines.
pokedex.quaquaval: Dancing in ways that evoke far-away places, this Pokémon mesmerizes all that see it. Flourishes of its decorative water feathers slice into its foes.
pokedex.lechonk: This Pokémon spurns all but the finest of foods. Its body gives off an herblike scent that bug Pokémon detest.
pokedex.oinkologne: It entrances female Pokémon with the sweet, alluring scent that wafts from all over its body.
pokedex.tarountula: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread’s strength is the topic of ongoing research.
pokedex.spidops: Spidops covers its territory in tough, sticky threads to set up traps for intruders.
pokedex.nymble: It’s highly skilled at a fighting style in which it uses its jumping capabilities to dodge incoming attacks while also dealing damage to opponents.
pokedex.lokix: It uses its normally folded third set of legs when in Showdown Mode. This places a huge burden on its body, so it can’t stay in this mode for long.
pokedex.pawmi: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.
pokedex.pawmo: Pawmo uses a unique fighting technique in which it uses its forepaws to strike foes and zap them with electricity from its paw pads simultaneously.
pokedex.pawmot: Pawmot’s fluffy fur acts as a battery. It can store the same amount of electricity as an electric car.
pokedex.tandemaus: The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.
pokedex.maushold: The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight.
pokedex.fidough: The yeast in Fidough’s breath is useful for cooking, so this Pokémon has been protected by people since long ago.
pokedex.dachsbun: The surface of this Pokémon’s skin hardens when exposed to intense heat, and its body has an appetizing aroma.
pokedex.smoliv: This Pokémon converts nutrients into oil, which it stores in the fruit on its head. It can easily go a whole week without eating or drinking.
pokedex.dolliv: It basks in the sun to its heart’s content until the fruits on its head ripen. After that, Dolliv departs from human settlements and goes on a journey.
pokedex.arboliva: This Pokémon drives back enemies by launching its rich, aromatic oil at them with enough force to smash a boulder.
pokedex.squawkabilly: Green-feathered flocks hold the most sway. When they’re out searching for food in the mornings and evenings, it gets very noisy.
pokedex.nacli: The ground scrapes its body as it travels, causing it to leave salt behind. Salt is constantly being created and replenished inside Nacli’s body.
pokedex.naclstack: It compresses rock salt inside its body and shoots out hardened salt pellets with enough force to perforate an iron sheet.
pokedex.garganacl: Many Pokémon gather around Garganacl, hoping to lick at its mineral-rich salt.
pokedex.charcadet: Its firepower increases when it fights, reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. It likes berries that are rich in fat.
pokedex.armarouge: This Pokémon clads itself in armor that has been fortified by psychic and fire energy, and it shoots blazing fireballs.
pokedex.ceruledge: An old set of armor steeped in grudges caused this Pokémon’s evolution. Ceruledge cuts its enemies to pieces without mercy.
pokedex.tadbulb: It floats using the electricity stored in its body. When thunderclouds are around, Tadbulb will float higher off the ground.
pokedex.bellibolt: What appear to be eyeballs are actually organs for discharging the electricity generated by Bellibolt’s belly-button dynamo.
pokedex.wattrel: These Pokémon make their nests on coastal cliffs. The nests have a strange, crackling texture, and they’re a popular delicacy.
pokedex.kilowattrel: It uses its throat sac to store electricity generated by its wings. There’s hardly any oil in its feathers, so it is a poor swimmer.
pokedex.maschiff: Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick fat makes for an excellent defense.
pokedex.mabosstiff: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.
pokedex.shroodle: To keep enemies away from its territory, it paints markings around its nest using a poisonous liquid that has an acrid odor.
pokedex.grafaiai: Each Grafaiai paints its own individual pattern, and it will paint that same pattern over and over again throughout its life.
pokedex.bramblin: Not even Bramblin knows where it is headed as it tumbles across the wilderness, blown by the wind. It loathes getting wet.
pokedex.brambleghast: Brambleghast wanders around arid regions. On rare occasions, mass outbreaks of these Pokémon will bury an entire town.
pokedex.toedscool: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.
pokedex.toedscruel: It coils its 10 tentacles around prey and sucks out their nutrients, causing the prey pain. The folds along the rim of its head are a popular delicacy.
pokedex.klawf: This Pokémon lives on sheer cliffs. It sidesteps opponents’ attacks, then lunges for their weak spots with its claws.
pokedex.capsakid: Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy because they include the shed front teeth of Capsakid among their ingredients.
pokedex.scovillain: The green head has turned vicious due to the spicy chemicals stimulating its brain. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.
pokedex.rellor: It rolls its mud ball around while the energy it needs for evolution matures. Eventually the time comes for it to evolve.
pokedex.rabsca: An infant sleeps inside the ball. Rabsca rolls the ball soothingly with its legs to ensure the infant sleeps comfortably.
pokedex.flittle: It spends its time running around wastelands. If anyone steals its beloved berries, it will chase them down and exact its revenge.
pokedex.espathra: It emits psychic power from the gaps between its multicolored frills and sprints at speeds greater than 120 mph.
pokedex.tinkatink: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it’s satisfied with the result.
pokedex.tinkatuff: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other’s hammers by smashing them together.
pokedex.tinkaton: The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it gets swung around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases and carries its plunder back home.
pokedex.wiglett: Though it looks like Diglett, Wiglett is an entirely different species. The resemblance seems to be a coincidental result of environmental adaptation.
pokedex.wugtrio: A variety of fish Pokémon, Wugtrio was once considered to be a regional form of Dugtrio.
pokedex.bombirdier: Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises.
pokedex.finizen: Its water ring is made from seawater mixed with a sticky fluid that Finizen secretes from its blowhole.
pokedex.palafin: Its physical capabilities are no different than a Finizen’s, but when its allies are in danger, it transforms and powers itself up.
pokedex.varoom: The steel section is Varoom’s actual body. This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.
pokedex.revavroom: Revavroom viciously threatens others with the sound of its exhaust. It sticks its tongue out from its cylindrical mouth and sprays toxic fluids.
pokedex.cyclizar: It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a human. The rider’s body heat warms Cyclizar’s back and lifts the Pokémon’s spirit.
pokedex.orthworm: This Pokémon lives in arid deserts. It maintains its metal body by consuming iron from the soil.
pokedex.glimmet: Glimmet’s toxic mineral crystals look just like flower petals. This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder like pollen to protect itself.
pokedex.glimmora: Glimmora’s petals are made of crystallized poison energy. It has recently become evident that these petals resemble Tera Jewels.
pokedex.greavard: This friendly Pokémon doesn’t like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.
pokedex.houndstone: A lovingly mourned Pokémon was reborn as Houndstone. It doesn’t like anyone touching the protuberance atop its head.
pokedex.flamigo: Thanks to a behavior of theirs known as “synchronizing,” an entire flock of these Pokémon can attack simultaneously in perfect harmony.
pokedex.cetoddle: It lives in frigid regions in pods of five or so individuals. It loves the minerals found in snow and ice.
pokedex.cetitan: Ice energy builds up in the horn on its upper jaw, causing the horn to reach cryogenic temperatures that freeze its surroundings.
pokedex.veluza: Veluza has excellent regenerative capabilities. It sheds spare flesh from its body to boost its agility, then charges at its prey.
pokedex.dondozo: It treats Tatsugiri like its boss and follows it loyally. Though powerful, Dondozo is apparently not very smart.
pokedex.tatsugiri: Tatsugiri is an extremely cunning Pokémon. It feigns weakness to lure in prey, then orders its partner to attack.
pokedex.annihilape: It imbues its fists with the power of the rage that it kept hidden in its heart. Opponents struck by these imbued fists will be shattered to their core.
pokedex.clodsire: It lives at the bottom of ponds and swamps. It will carry Wooper on its back and ferry them across water from one shore to the other.
pokedex.farigiraf: The hardened head from the tail protects the head of the main body as Farigiraf whips its long neck around to headbutt enemies.
pokedex.dudunsparce: It drives enemies out of its nest by sucking in enough air to fill its long, narrow lungs, then releasing the air in an intense blast.
pokedex.kingambit: Though it commands a massive army in battle, it’s not skilled at devising complex strategies. It just uses brute strength to keep pushing.
pokedex.great-tusk: This creature resembles a mysterious Pokémon that, according to a paranormal magazine, has lived since ancient times.
pokedex.scream-tail: It resembles a mysterious Pokémon described in a paranormal magazine as a Jigglypuff from one billion years ago.
pokedex.brute-bonnet: It bears a slight resemblance to a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a cross between a dinosaur and a mushroom.
pokedex.flutter-mane: It has similar features to a ghostly pterosaur that was covered in a paranormal magazine, but the two have little else in common.
pokedex.slither-wing: This Pokémon somewhat resembles an ancient form of Volcarona that was introduced in a dubious magazine.
pokedex.sandy-shocks: It slightly resembles a Magneton that lived for 10,000 years and was featured in an article in a paranormal magazine.
pokedex.iron-treads: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. It resembles a mysterious object described in an old expedition journal.
pokedex.iron-bundle: It resembles a mysterious object mentioned in an old book. There are only two reported sightings of this Pokémon.
pokedex.iron-hands: This Pokémon shares many similarities with Iron Hands, an object mentioned in a certain expedition journal.
pokedex.iron-jugulis: It’s possible that Iron Jugulis, an object described in an old book, may actually be this Pokémon.
pokedex.iron-moth: No records exist of this species being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon’s traits match up with an object described in an old book.
pokedex.iron-thorns: Some of its notable features match those of an object named within a certain expedition journal as Iron Thorns.
pokedex.frigibax: This Pokémon lives in forests and craggy areas. Using the power of its dorsal fin, it cools the inside of its nest like a refrigerator.
pokedex.arctibax: It attacks with the blade of its frozen dorsal fin by doing a front flip in the air. Arctibax’s strong back and legs allow it to pull off this technique.
pokedex.baxcalibur: It launches itself into battle by flipping upside down and spewing frigid air from its mouth. It finishes opponents off with its dorsal blade.
pokedex.gimmighoul: It lives inside an old treasure chest. Sometimes it gets left in shop corners since no one realizes it’s actually a Pokémon.
pokedex.gholdengo: It has a sturdy body made up of stacked coins. Gholdengo overwhelms its enemies by firing coin after coin at them in quick succession.
pokedex.wo-chien: It drains the life-force from vegetation, causing nearby forests to instantly wither and fields to turn barren.
pokedex.chien-pao: The hatred of those who perished by the sword long ago has clad itself in snow and become a Pokémon.
pokedex.ting-lu: It slowly brings its exceedingly heavy head down upon the ground, splitting the earth open with huge fissures that run over 160 feet deep.
pokedex.chi-yu: The envy accumulated within curved beads that sparked multiple conflicts has clad itself in fire and become a Pokémon.
pokedex.roaring-moon: According to an article in a dubious magazine, this Pokémon has some connection to a phenomenon that occurs in a certain region.
pokedex.iron-valiant: It’s possible that this is the object listed as Iron Valiant in a certain expedition journal.
pokedex.koraidon: This Pokémon resembles Cyclizar, but it is far burlier and more ferocious. Nothing is known about its ecology or other features.
pokedex.miraidon: This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an old book. The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.
pokedex.walking-wake: It resembles an illustration published in a paranormal magazine, said to be a depiction of a super-ancient Suicune.
pokedex.iron-leaves: According to the few eyewitness accounts that exist, it used its shining blades to julienne large trees and boulders.
pokedex.dipplin: The head sticking out belongs to the fore-wyrm, while the tail belongs to the core-wyrm. The two share one apple and help each other out.
pokedex.poltchageist: Poltchageist looks like a regional form of Sinistea, but it was recently discovered that the two Pokémon are entirely unrelated.
pokedex.sinistcha: It prefers cool, dark places, such as the back of a shelf or the space beneath a home's floorboards. It wanders in search of prey after sunset.
pokedex.okidogi: Okidogi is a ruffian with a short temper. It can pulverize anything by swinging around the chain on its neck.
pokedex.munkidori: Munkidori keeps itself somewhere safe while it toys with its foes, using psychokinesis to induce intense dizziness.
pokedex.fezandipiti: Fezandipiti beats its glossy wings to scatter pheromones that captivate people and Pokémon.
pokedex.ogerpon: This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.
pokedex.archaludon: It digs holes on mountains, searching for food. It’s so durable that being caught in a cave-in won’t faze it.
pokedex.hydrapple: These capricious syrpents have banded together. On the rare occasion that their moods align, their true power is unleashed.
pokedex.gouging-fire: It resembles an eerie Pokémon once shown in a paranormal magazine. That Pokémon was said to be an Entei regenerated from a fossil.
pokedex.raging-bolt: It bears resemblance to a Pokémon that became a hot topic for a short while after a paranormal magazine touted it as Raikou's ancestor.
pokedex.iron-boulder: It was named after a mysterious object recorded in an old book. Its body seems to be metallic.
pokedex.iron-crown: There was supposedly an incident in which it launched shining blades to cut everything around it to pieces. Little else is known about it.
pokedex.terapagos: It’s thought that this Pokémon lived in ancient Paldea until it got caught in seismic shifts and went extinct.
pokedex.pecharunt: Its peach-shaped shell serves as storage for a potent poison. It makes poisonous mochi and serves them to people and Pokémon.

moves.spin-out: The user spins furiously by straining its legs, inflicting damage on the target. This also harshly lowers the user's Speed stat.
moves.population-bomb: The user’s fellows gather in droves to perform a combo attack that hits the target one to ten times in a row.
moves.ice-spinner: The user covers its feet in thin ice and twirls around, slamming into the target. This move's spinning motion also destroys the terrain.

moves.salt-cure: The user salt cures the target, inflicting damage every turn. Steel and Water types are more strongly affected by this move.
moves.triple-dive: The user performs a perfectly timed triple dive, hitting the target with splashes of water three times in a row.
moves.mortal-spin: The user performs a spin attack that can also eliminate the effects of such moves as Bind, Wrap, and Leech Seed. This also poisons opposing Pokémon.
moves.doodle: The user captures the very essence of the target in a sketch. This changes the Abilities of the user and its ally Pokémon to that of the target.
moves.fillet-away: The user sharply boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats by using its own HP.
moves.kowtow-cleave: The user slashes at the target after kowtowing to make the target let down its guard. This attack never misses.
moves.flower-trick: The user throws a rigged bouquet of flowers at the target. This attack never misses and always lands a critical hit.
moves.torch-song: The user blows out raging flames as if singing a song, scorching the target. This also boosts the user's Sp. Atk stat.
moves.aqua-step: The user toys with the target and attacks it using light and fluid dance steps. This also boosts the user's Speed stat.
moves.raging-bull: The user performs a tackle like a raging bull. This move's type depends on the user's form. It can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.
moves.make-it-rain: The user attacks by throwing out a mass of coins. This also lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat. Money is earned after the battle.

moves.ruination: The user summons a ruinous disaster. This cuts the target’s HP in half.

moves.electro-drift: The user races forward at ultrafast speeds, piercing its target with futuristic electricity. This move's power is boosted more than usual if it's a supereffective hit.

moves.trailblaze: The user attacks suddenly as if leaping out from tall grass. The user's nimble footwork boosts its Speed stat.
moves.chilling-water: The user attacks the target by showering it with water that's so cold it saps the target's power. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.

moves.rage-fist: The user converts its rage into energy to attack. The more times the user has been hit by attacks, the greater the move's power.
moves.armor-cannon: The user shoots its own armor out as blazing projectiles. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.

moves.comeuppance: The user retaliates with much greater force against the opponent that last inflicted damage on it.
moves.aqua-cutter: The user expels pressurized water to cut at the target like a blade. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.thunderclap: This move enables the user to attack first with a jolt of electricity. This move fails if the target is not readying an attack.
moves.mighty-cleave: The user wields the light that has accumulated atop its head to cleave the target. This move hits even if the target protects itself.

items.endorsement: A letter of recommendation that you’ll need in order to participate in the Gym Challenge.
items.pokemon-box-link: A device that allows you to access the Pokémon storage system. There are some places where it won’t work.
items.wishing-star: A stone found in the Galar region with a mysterious power. It’s said that your dreams come true if you find one.

items.fishing-rod--galar: Use it by the water to fish up various kinds of Pokémon.
items.rotom-bike: This bike can be combined with the Pokémon Rotom to use a turbo boost.
